title: Still Waters
summary: A raider chief called Skell holds the Rustwater wells and poisons everyone who comes for water. Marl wants her dead and the wells reopened.

stages.title: Kill Skell, the Well-Witch
stages.description: Return to the Rustwater wells and put down the raider chief Skell.

stages.title: Report to Marl
stages.description: Tell Marl the wells are clear.
